name: Sphinx
description: The sphinx is a mythological composite creature — combining human and animal features, primarily a human head and lion body — that appears in both ancient Egyptian and ancient Greek traditions with distinct roles: guardian and royal symbol in Egypt, riddle-posing deadly monster in Greece.

aliases.name: Andro-sphinx
aliases.meaning: Male-headed sphinx (Egyptian type); from Greek andros (male)

aliases.name: Σφίγξ
aliases.meaning: Sphinx; possibly from sphingein (to squeeze/strangle), referring to the lion's killing method

aliases.name: Shesep-ankh
aliases.meaning: 'Living image'; proposed Egyptian origin of the word sphinx

origin: Ancient Egypt, ancient Greece, and subsequently throughout the Mediterranean world and into South and Southeast Asia through cultural diffusion. Physical sphinx statues survive primarily in Egypt and in museums worldwide.
